about.description:
**The self-improving AI agent built by [Nous Research](https://nousresearch.com).**
It's the only agent with a built-in learning loop — it creates skills from experience,
improves them during use, nudges itself to persist knowledge, searches its own past conversations, and builds a deepening model of who you are across sessions.
Run it on a $5 VPS, a GPU cluster, or serverless infrastructure that costs nearly nothing when idle.
It's not tied to your laptop — talk to it from Telegram while it works on a cloud VM.

Use any model you want —
[Nous Portal](https://portal.nousresearch.com), OpenRouter, OpenAI, your own endpoint, and [many others](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/integrations/providers).
Switch with `hermes model` — no code changes, no lock-in.
about.summary: The agent that grows with you

script: python -c "import importlib.metadata as m; assert m.version('hermes-agent') == '0.23.2'"

python -c "from hermes_constants import get_bundled_skills_dir as b; p = b(); assert (p / 'software-development' / 'codebase-inspection' / 'SKILL.md').is_file(); assert not (p / 'productivity' / 'powerpoint').exists()"
python -c "from hermes_constants import get_optional_skills_dir as o; assert (o() / 'research' / 'parallel-cli' / 'SKILL.md').is_file()"
python -c "from hermes_constants import get_optional_mcps_dir as m; assert (m() / 'linear' / 'manifest.yaml').is_file()"
python -c "from agent.i18n import _locales_dir; assert (_locales_dir() / 'en.yaml').is_file()"
python -c "from hermes_cli.main_tui_launch import _find_bundled_tui; assert _find_bundled_tui().is_file()"
python -c "from hermes_cli.web_server import WEB_DIST; assert (WEB_DIST / 'index.html').is_file()"
python -c "from hermes_cli.plugins import get_bundled_plugins_dir as p; assert (p() / 'security-guidance' / 'plugin.yaml').is_file()"
python -c "from hermes_cli.version_info import get_version_info; v = get_version_info(); assert v.base_version == '0.23.2'; assert v.commit == 'ae2a81ccc00e9b7c06301523e5bb09608397149c'"
hermes --help
hermes-agent --help
hermes-acp --help

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  # Upstream switched from calendar tags to semantic versions.
  version: "0.23.2"
  python_min: "3.14"

package:
  name: hermes-agent
  # Epoch 1 makes this newer than the previously published 2026.7.20.
  version: 1!${{ version }}

source:
  # Build the web/TUI assets and their license report from the tagged sources.
  url: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7e828086c549fc2d90c16795daf416a81a8180d8a52b5d4a29656f7a2ba8f827

  patches:
    - conda-packaging.patch
    - optional-features.patch

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  variant:
    ignore_keys:
      - nodejs
  python:
    entry_points:
      - hermes = hermes_cli.main:main
      - hermes-agent = agent.legacy_cli:main
      - hermes-acp = acp_adapter.entry:main

requirements:
  build:
    - nodejs >=26
    - pnpm >=12.15,<13
    - pnpm-licenses
  host:
    - pip
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools ==84.1.0
    - wheel ==0.48.0
  run:
    - ffmpeg
    - git
    - nodejs >=26
    - python >=${{ python_min }},<3.15
    - ripgrep
    - openai ==2.54.0
    - certifi ==2026.10.19
    - truststore ==0.10.5
    - python-dotenv ==1.2.4
    - fire ==0.7.1
    - httpx ==0.28.1
    - socksio
    - rich ==14.3.4
    - tomli-w ==1.2.0
    - ruamel.yaml ==0.18.16
    - ruamel.yaml.clib ==0.2.15
    - requests ==2.34.2
    - jinja2 ==3.1.6
    - pydantic ==2.14.1
    - prompt_toolkit ==3.0.53
    - croniter ==6.2.4
    - snowballstemmer ==3.1.1
    - packaging ==26.3
    - markdown ==3.11.2
    - pyjwt ==2.15.1
    - urllib3 >=2.8.0,<3
    - cryptography ==50.0.2
    - psutil ==7.2.2
    - websockets ==15.0.1
    - pathspec ==1.1.1
    - fastapi >=0.104.0,<1
    - uvicorn >=0.31.0,<1
    - httptools >=0.6.3,<0.9
    - watchfiles >=0.20,<2
    - pillow ==13.0.0
    - pillow-heif >=1.4.0,<2
    - resvg-py ==0.5.0
    - python-multipart >=0.0.9,<1
    - if: unix
      then:
        # openssh is not available on win-64; Windows provides it separately.
        - openssh
        - ptyprocess >=0.7.0,<1
    - if: linux
      then:
        - __linux
        # Support the clipboard under both Wayland and X11 sessions.
        - wl-clipboard-rs
        - xclip
    - if: osx
      then:
        - __osx
    - if: win
      then:
        - __win
        - pywinpty >=3.0.5,<4
        - pywin32 >=306,<312
        - python-tzdata ==2025.3
        - concurrent-log-handler ==0.9.30

    # PyPI calls this nemo-relay. Conda-forge also provides Intel macOS builds,
    # so the upstream wheel-availability marker is not needed here.
    - python-nemo-relay >=0.11,<0.12

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - acp_adapter
        - agent
        - batch_runner
        - cli
        - cron
        - gateway
        - hermes_bootstrap
        - hermes_cli
        - hermes_agent
        - hermes_platform
        - pm
        - hermes_constants
        - hermes_logging
        - hermes_state
        - hermes_time
        - model_tools
        - plugins
        - providers
        - run_agent
        - tools
        - toolset_distributions
        - toolsets
        - trajectory_compressor
        - tui_gateway
        - utils
      pip_check: true

  - script:
      - python -c "import importlib.metadata as m; assert m.version('hermes-agent') == '0.23.2'"
      - python -c "from hermes_constants import get_bundled_skills_dir as b; p = b(); assert (p / 'software-development' / 'codebase-inspection' / 'SKILL.md').is_file(); assert not (p / 'productivity' / 'powerpoint').exists()"
      - python -c "from hermes_constants import get_optional_skills_dir as o; assert (o() / 'research' / 'parallel-cli' / 'SKILL.md').is_file()"
      - python -c "from hermes_constants import get_optional_mcps_dir as m; assert (m() / 'linear' / 'manifest.yaml').is_file()"
      - python -c "from agent.i18n import _locales_dir; assert (_locales_dir() / 'en.yaml').is_file()"
      - python -c "from hermes_cli.main_tui_launch import _find_bundled_tui; assert _find_bundled_tui().is_file()"
      - python -c "from hermes_cli.web_server import WEB_DIST; assert (WEB_DIST / 'index.html').is_file()"
      - python -c "from hermes_cli.plugins import get_bundled_plugins_dir as p; assert (p() / 'security-guidance' / 'plugin.yaml').is_file()"
      - python -c "from hermes_cli.version_info import get_version_info; v = get_version_info(); assert v.base_version == '0.23.2'; assert v.commit == 'ae2a81ccc00e9b7c06301523e5bb09608397149c'"
      - hermes --help
      - hermes-agent --help
      - hermes-acp --help
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*

  - script: test_optional_features.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  homepage: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com
  documentation: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs
  repository: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent
  license: MIT AND Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - skills/creative/humanizer/LICENSE
    - skills/productivity/pdf/LICENSE
    - skills/productivity/microsoft-office/LICENSE
    - plugins/hermes-achievements/LICENSE
    - plugins/security-guidance/LICENSE
    - plugins/security-guidance/NOTICE
    - third-party-licenses.txt
  summary: The agent that grows with you
  description: |
    **The self-improving AI agent built by [Nous Research](https://nousresearch.com).**
    It's the only agent with a built-in learning loop — it creates skills from experience,
    improves them during use, nudges itself to persist knowledge, searches its own past conversations, and builds a deepening model of who you are across sessions.
    Run it on a $5 VPS, a GPU cluster, or serverless infrastructure that costs nearly nothing when idle.
    It's not tied to your laptop — talk to it from Telegram while it works on a cloud VM.

    Use any model you want —
    [Nous Portal](https://portal.nousresearch.com), OpenRouter, OpenAI, your own endpoint, and [many others](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/integrations/providers).
    Switch with `hermes model` — no code changes, no lock-in.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - eunos-1128
